contentList.content:
Full Moon

At a quarter health a marked boss turns vulnerable to one random damage type, while every other type is reflected back at the attacker.
The boss itself enters a desperate state, gaining extra resources.

A demanding mechanic for the well-prepared.

Enable?

Eclipse

Once a marked boss drops below half health, divine grace descends on it, stripping all harmful effects and restoring its resources,
while the party must pass saving throws to keep control of the fight.

During Eclipse the boss grows notably stronger and can take a full turn.

Enable?
